description: A report's flight category (AC 00-45H, AIM 7-1-7), metar::flight_category_of, the same rule as flight_category: LIFR under 500 ft or a mile, IFR under 1,000 ft or 3, MVFR to 3,000 ft or 5, else VFR, no ceiling no limit; with no visibility only a ceiling under 500 ft settles it (LIFR), else null; with ceiling_unknown (a ceiling reported with no height) LIFR under a mile's visibility, else null.
